summary: Fulcrum Therapeutics disclosed discontinuation of its pociredir program for sickle cell disease after FDA feedback citing heightened malignancy risk linked to the PRC2 class, following Tazverik's global withdrawal. Concurrently, the board initiated a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives to maximize stockholder value. No specific terms (price, premium, deadline) or advisors were named. The filing constitutes a strategic review announcement under Item 8.01. The stock will become binary on any future transaction announcement. Watch for potential merger, asset sale, or liquidation as alternatives are explored.
